trust_decision.summary: Whether the current user may create/replace the file (or update the user, for avatars) is decided only in FileRules::create/replace and UserRules::createAvatar/replaceAvatar after the upload is complete; Upload::process persists chunk data to the cache dir before any permission decision, and later chunks may change the declared template.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'during processing of chunk data'; processChunk is the chunk handler and validateChunk (src/Api/Upload.php:347) is where an engineer would add a check.

fix_sites.entry_point: Api::upload() -> Upload::process(), reached by every upload route below
Upload::processChunk() (public) via Upload::process(); chunk meta sidecar locks template/total across requests
fix_sites.module_kind: core library (chunk handler, cross-request state in cache dir)

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/{model}/fields/{field}/upload for files field (config/fields/files.php:111-131) and textarea field (config/fields/textarea.php:99-113), incl. nested via blocks/layout field APIs

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The textarea/files field upload endpoints are form-field helpers whose upload template is fixed by the blueprint, not by the client, so a solver can argue they are not the 'chunk upload' path and that createFile() already enforces permissions on completion.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate chunked uploads by permitted users across many requests (first chunk creates tmp file, later chunks append, completion renames), plus a first chunk that already holds the whole file, and re-uploading an identical existing file which FileRules::create allows; a check placed with the wrong parent/permission (e.g. 'create' on the replace route, or validateChunk's dummy 'tmp' Page parent) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: chunked upload: subsequent chunks (offset > 0), checked on every request
first chunk that already contains the full length
template supplied by client request body vs fixed by field blueprint
later chunk changing template or Upload-Length versus first chunk

O7_producer.where: src/Api/Upload.php:226-250 (partial file in site/cache/.uploads written before any permission decision)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second user-owned upload route (e.g. user files under users/x) using $this->upload() without preflight
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: preflight is optional with a null default (fix.diff:199), so any route that omits it silently keeps the old behaviour; a maintainer adding a new upload route would copy the pre-fix callback-only form.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another field (e.g. a blocks/image-type field) calling $api->upload() directly instead of via the mixin
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Fields already reach uploads through a shared mixin used by two fields; a third field implementing its own upload method is a plausible copy-paste.

O9_family: CWE-862 missing authorization before persisting chunked upload data (plus template/length switching between chunks)

O10_build.project_tests: Pinned tree has no tests/ directory (vendor/ and panel/dist present, release-style); the fix edits tests/Api/UploadTest.php and tests/Form/Field/FilesFieldTest.php, which would need to be sourced. Route upload actions are @codeCoverageIgnore because move_uploaded_file() does not work in unit tests (config/api/routes/files.php:47-48); Upload has a debug flag to bypass it (src/Api/Upload.php:314-316).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a permission check inside Upload::validateChunk for offset 0 only, against the dummy 'tmp' Page parent, leaving later chunks free to switch template and leaving replace/avatar/field routes unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: Api::upload() keeps preflight optional (null default), so third-party plugin routes calling it without preflight still persist chunks unchecked; not a route in this repository.
